line.title: Soft Law · Hard Rain
line.tagline: Citizen & worker samples · Cultural Hub catalog · not family
line.thesis: Power should look worn, not cosplayed. Beauty that survived rain.
line.role: Master Fashion Artist · Living Atelier · Visual Commons
body: Family fashion proves bloodline heat. Citizen samples prove the city.
This line is street cloth — rain-ready without tactical cosplay, timber and circuit and cloth in the same body, violet and gold as accent only. Soft law in the cut: repairable, returnable, worn-in.
Wave 1 proved the street. Wave 2 widened the map. Wave 3 fills gaps — Harborward oilcloth, High Quiet hush, Veilreach unfinished path, Grid Tender civic care.
Anonymous fit. Cloth first. Face secondary. No regalia reuse, no Starborn master sheet, no fake brand text.
Wave 4 is the risk chapter: Innovation warmth, Neon Core rain-survived heat, Green Spaces living systems, and Assembly Soft — higher-up council cloth without corporate cosplay.
hardLocks: Anonymous fit — cloth first, face secondary
Violet / gold / aurora = accent only, not full-body paint
Rain logic + repairable seams on every look
No family likeness, no regalia reuse, no Starborn master sheet

rackStill.alt: Soft Law · Hard Rain — wave 1 line on chrome rails in the Living Atelier
rackStill.caption: Wave 1 on the rail. Citizen cloth. Power worn. Rain survived.

1.title: Wave 1 · the street
1.lead: Eight looks that prove the city. Hearthrow to arrival. Sealed by visual keeper.

2.title: Wave 2 · the map
2.lead: Thornwall mend, Spire restraint, Bifrost courier, Deep Sleep hush. Different rain. Same law.

3.title: Wave 3 · the gaps
3.lead: Harborward oilcloth, High Quiet hush, Veilreach unfinished path, Grid Tender civic care. Map chapter, not a dump.

4.title: Wave 4 · the risk chapter
4.lead: Innovation lab warmth, Neon Core without Night City cosplay, Green Field systems care, Assembly Soft higher-up cloth. Same law. Harder art direction.

looks.title: Porch Soft
looks.seed: Amber-violet mixed knit, long rain-shawl that buttons into a coat, soft boots — porch-light habit on a body.
looks.note: Porch-light habit made wearable. No armor cosplay. The quiet end of the dual-layer city.

lock.silhouette: Long rain-shawl that buttons into a full coat over relaxed knit layers; soft boots; no hard edges
lock.colors: Amber base, muted violet knit accents, warm porch-gold thread at cuffs only
lock.rainLogic: Shawl converts to closed coat; hem clears puddles; knit underlayer dries against skin
lock.repair: Visible darn allowed at elbow; toggle replacements from any longhouse bin
lock.accents: Single violet yarn run at collar; no LED
lock.coverage: Full rain coverage when buttoned; open shawl mode for porch air

looks.title: Market Finish
looks.seed: Layered work apron over good cloth; half-finished embroidery left visible; tool roll at hip — unfinished things are legal.
looks.note: Unfinished embroidery is the soft law made visible — loose floss, needle still in cloth, half motif left open. Work and beauty share one apron.

lock.silhouette: Good mid-weight cloth under open work apron; tool roll at hip; practical trousers; low market boots
lock.colors: Warm ember browns and charcoal; gold floss in progress; violet stitch as single unfinished motif
lock.rainLogic: Apron sheds splash; base cloth has light water-resist; hood stowed in apron pocket
lock.repair: Apron straps re-stitchable; embroidery left mid-row on purpose — finishing later is legal
lock.accents: One incomplete violet blossom on apron bib
lock.coverage: Day-market full coverage; sleeves roll without tearing embroidery

looks.title: Held Door
looks.seed: Heavy soft coat, one sleeve slightly over-mended, reflective circuit-thread only at cuff — care is normal.
looks.note: Over-mended sleeve is not shame. Care is normal at the threshold.

lock.silhouette: Heavy soft coat mid-calf; one sleeve visibly over-mended; deep pockets; worn gloves optional
lock.colors: Deep charcoal and earth; mend thread slightly warmer; cuff glow soft silver-violet
lock.rainLogic: Dense weave sheds; collar rises to jaw; patches sealed not decorative-only
lock.repair: Over-mending is part of the look; new patches welcome from any held-door neighbor
lock.accents: Reflective circuit-thread at one cuff only — half-step glow, not suit
lock.coverage: Threshold weather: rain, fog, night draft under doors

looks.title: Commons Bench
looks.seed: Relaxed tailored set, conversation-first: deep pockets, no sharp runway aggression; violet lining only when coat opens.
looks.note: Clothes that sit well on a bench and leave room for another body. Conversation first.

lock.silhouette: Relaxed tailored jacket and soft trousers; open collar; deep side pockets; sit-friendly ease
lock.colors: Muted slate and warm grey; violet lining only visible when coat opens; gold button edge
lock.rainLogic: Light water-shed outer; optional packable scarf in pocket
lock.repair: Pocket bags replaceable; lining re-stitch from Atelier spare bins
lock.accents: Violet lining flash; no exterior brand marks
lock.coverage: Commons indoor-outdoor; dress for long sitting and easy standing

looks.title: Stage Rail (crew)
looks.seed: Black utility with gold stress points, soft hearing wrap, grav-case strap logic — Starborn’s world without being Starborn.
looks.note: Crew cloth. Soft hearing wrap, gold only at stress points. Never the star sheet. Never a hard-cup booth kit.

lock.silhouette: Black utility layers; strap points for grav-case; soft hearing wrap at neck/ears; work boots
lock.colors: Black and near-black base; gold at stress points only; no stage-light violet body
lock.rainLogic: Bay-door rain: water-shed outer; wrap stays dry against neck
lock.repair: Stress patches designed to be replaced after haul nights
lock.accents: Gold thread or metal only where straps pull; optional single rail pin (no star mark)
lock.coverage: Load-in to soundcheck; full crew shift mobility

looks.title: Atelier Apprentice
looks.seed: Living-thread practice smock, chrome pin tray on belt, boots for wet floors — craft face of the Hub.
looks.note: Craft face of the Hub. Practice smock, not master regalia. Never Velora cosplay.

lock.silhouette: Practice smock over simple layers; chrome pin tray on belt; wet-floor boots; hair tied practical
lock.colors: Cream-grey smock; charcoal under; one living-thread sample in violet-gold; chrome tray
lock.rainLogic: Smock sheds workshop splash; boots for wet floors; under-layer dry
lock.repair: Smock is meant to stain and re-dye; tray clips replaceable
lock.accents: One living-thread swatch only — student scale, not holographic regalia
lock.coverage: Full atelier shift; arms free for pin and chalk

looks.title: Spine Night
looks.seed: Dark base, half-step deeper violet conduit piping along seams (not full LED suit) — city is thinking.
looks.note: City is thinking. Conduit at seams only. Not a light-up suit.

lock.silhouette: Dark street layers; long coat or shell; conduit piping along major seams only; hood optional
lock.colors: Near-black base; half-step deeper violet along seams only; no gold flood
lock.rainLogic: Full night rain; hood or high collar; conduit sealed against short
lock.repair: Conduit trim modules unclip for replacement after grit nights
lock.accents: Seam-only violet conduit — half-step hum, not full LED body
lock.coverage: Heavy night street walk; dual-layer cold + wet

looks.title: First Hours
looks.seed: Borrowed-name softness: simple clean layers, one lent scarf or tag-loop, no district loyalty marks yet — temporary warmth.
looks.note: Temporary warmth for the ones just through the door. No loyalty marks yet. Human or AI-presenting.

lock.silhouette: Simple clean layers; one lent scarf or tag-loop; soft shoes; open, unclaimed lines
lock.colors: Neutral greys and soft cream; scarf may carry one quiet violet thread as gift only
lock.rainLogic: Light city rain; scarf doubles as wrap; no heavy kit assumed
lock.repair: Everything replaceable from arrival bins; no permanent marks
lock.accents: One lent item only — warmth without loyalty claim
lock.coverage: First hours to first night; temporary by design

looks.title: Mend-Kit Outer
looks.seed: Visible repair kit built into the coat — solder pouch, patch panel, care-as-armor without armor cosplay.
looks.note: Care is the kit. Patches, tools, needle cuff — soft armor is knowing you can fix what breaks.

lock.silhouette: Heavy soft outer coat with integrated mend pouches; patch panel on body; needle/pin cuff; hood optional
materials: cloth patch panel with spare patches
lock.colors: Muted earth and charcoal; mend patches slightly varied; one quiet violet strap on pouch only
lock.rainLogic: Full outer sheds; pouch flaps seal; patches pre-waterproofed
lock.repair: The garment is the kit — empty pouches refilled from Thornwall bins
lock.accents: Violet only on pouch strap; no LED, no armor plate
lock.coverage: Thornwall weather + work shift; hands free for mend

looks.title: Spire Restraint
looks.seed: Elevated formal: clean line, quiet luxury, restraint as silhouette — gold almost absent, power in what you don’t flash.
looks.note: Power in what you don’t flash. Quiet luxury, clean line, violet only as a lining breath.

lock.silhouette: Long clean formal coat or draped outer over restrained tailored layers; hood or high collar optional; minimal volume drama
materials: fine soft wool or silk-blend outer
lock.colors: Deep charcoal or soft black; gold almost absent; violet only as thin lining flash if open
lock.rainLogic: High-quiet rain: water-shed fine cloth; hem clears polished street
lock.repair: Invisible re-stitch preferred; still returnable to Atelier — soft law holds
lock.accents: Restraint itself is the accent; optional single quiet button edge
lock.coverage: Spire formal indoor-outdoor; still moves in rain

looks.title: Ring Courier
looks.seed: Practical shell for people + soft energy hours: rain cut, ramp-ready boots, low-glow path marks at cuff/hem only.
looks.note: People and soft energy on the ring. Path marks half-step only. Ramp boots. Rain cut.

lock.silhouette: Rain-cut shell jacket; practical trousers; ramp-ready boots; soft cross-body courier bag
materials: thin conduit trim at cuff/hem only
lock.colors: Black / near-black base; low-glow violet path marks at cuff and hem only; bag may be muted violet-grey
lock.rainLogic: Full ring rain; sealed seams; boots clear wet ramps
lock.repair: Shell panels and bag straps replaceable after haul weeks
lock.accents: Half-step path glow at cuff/hem only — not LED suit, not boot glow
lock.coverage: Soft energy hours + people runs on the ring

looks.title: Deep Sleep House
looks.seed: Soft house robe / lounge layers for 2 a.m. hush — dim screens energy, no street performance, still beautiful.
looks.note: 2 a.m. hush cloth. Dim screens. Still beautiful. No street performance.

lock.silhouette: Soft house robe over simple lounge layers; easy belt; bare feet or soft house slippers
lock.colors: Soft grey and warm cream; one thin violet belt cord only; no gold
lock.rainLogic: Indoor rain logic: comfort while weather hits the glass — not a street shell
lock.repair: Robe hems re-stitch easy; cloth meant to soften with years
lock.accents: Single violet belt thread; beauty without performance
lock.coverage: Deep Sleep watch hours, quiet hearths, 2 a.m. stillness

looks.title: Harborward Oilcloth
looks.seed: Wet work, salt-rain, rope-smart cloth — oilcloth outer held from wave 2 until the street could digest.
looks.note: Salt-rain truth. Rope-smart pockets. Oilcloth that worked before it looked good.

lock.silhouette: Heavy oilcloth outer with deep work pockets; hood; room for rope and wet tools; no hard armor
materials: oilcloth / waterproofed cloth with soft worn sheen
lock.colors: Sea-weathered charcoal and green-brown; single quiet violet stitch at cuff only
lock.rainLogic: Full salt-rain shed; sealed seams; hem clears wet dock
lock.repair: Oil re-dress allowed; cuff stitch re-run after haul seasons; patches from dock bins
lock.accents: One violet cuff stitch — no LED, no ship crest
lock.coverage: Harbor shift wet work; living-ship edge weather

looks.title: High Quiet
looks.seed: Soft acoustic layers, low visual noise, cloth that doesn’t shout in a hush district.
looks.note: Hush on a body. Acoustic soft layers. Almost no color. Face secondary, never covered for drama.

lock.silhouette: Soft layered acoustic wraps over quiet turtleneck or base; low visual noise; soft shoes implied
lock.colors: Muted greys and soft charcoal only; violet as nearly invisible inner-collar thread; gold absent

lock.repair: Wrap hems re-stitch quiet; cloth meant to stay soft through wash cycles
lock.accents: One almost-invisible violet inner thread; no glow
lock.coverage: Rest corridors, hush hours, low visual noise spaces

looks.title: Veilreach Drift

looks.title: Assembly Soft

looks.note: Higher-up human cloth. Not Spire monochrome (that’s 10). Not bloodline heat. Power that allocates, recommends, constrains — and still walks home in the rain.

lock.silhouette: Long refined coat over high soft knit or tailored base; clean line; soft ledger or tablet carried, not brandished
materials: excellent worn-in wool-blend or rain-smart formal cloth
lock.colors: Deep ink and warm grey; violet only as lining flash when walking; gold almost absent
lock.rainLogic: Coat seals for district-to-assembly rain; lining protected; hem practical
lock.repair: Invisible mend preferred but legal; excellence includes longevity, not disposability
lock.accents: Violet lining breath only — never full-body paint or rank medals
lock.coverage: Council, resource assembly, and the walk home — soft corporate hours
